propositions: Multiple production bugs (3435, 3a33, 4dd2, 4c6c class) resulted from store write paths that bypassed canonical write seams with raw git commands, including in GitHub workflow YAML

A deterministic two-layer CI lint (Python AST layer + workflow/shell cwd-aware layer) must flag raw git mutations at the subprocess and wrapper-call level with opaque-argv fail-closed semantics, unless marked with an inline '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' marker

The two sanctioned write seams are the store seam (locked transaction/append internals in gitutil, event_append, txn, purge_bridge) and the reconciler seam (git_adapter, _ref_lock), with all other raw git writes to the tracker being unauthorized bypasses
Intra-function local tracking must resolve argv shape (literal, local-variable/splat, or opaque) to catch the codebase's own write idioms and prevent future bypasses copying those patterns

Report-mode bootstrap identifies the authoritative inventory of seam-internal sites, maintenance-command callers, and disposable-workspace repos (eval_solver, criterion_preview, gerrit_client, opcert_service/workspace) that require markers; all hits must be remediated or reasoned before enforcement is enabled

Teaching message must direct authors to sanctioned store write APIs (event-append/transaction/reconciler) and document the marker convention as distinct from tickets-boundary-ok; accepted residual is cross-function and dynamic argv construction beyond intra-function tracking
